run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the maximum possible difference between two subsets of an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input arrays to verify correct subset difference calculation
review_f_gold: review f_gold which cancels duplicate elements and sums unique positives versus negatives
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that finds the maximum difference by pairing duplicates and grouping unique values
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid mutating the input array when cancelling duplicate elements
